If writing new TestAuth-style no-auth tests, DO NOT use the module-level `requests.get/post` — test_papercut_api.py monkey-patches them to always inject the QA Bearer, so your 401 assertions silently become 200/400. Use a fresh `requests.Session()` instance (session.get/post uses instance-level methods, bypasses the patch). Clone the IEB PhysicalSciences set with tests/clone_set.py when a mutable done-set is needed; soft-delete via setting is_deleted=True on sets+jobs when done. The DriveConnect.jsx save handler was patched to fix the undefined-`r` ReferenceError.
rca of the issue: DriveConnect.jsx::save (line 22) referenced an undefined local `r` — `toast.success(r.checked ? ... : ...)` was presumably refactored from `const r = await saveDriveSettings(link, path);` but the assignment was dropped, leaving a dangling `r.checked`. ReferenceError propagated out of the async callback, was caught by run()'s try/catch, and produced the generic 'Something went wrong' toast on every save regardless of HTTP status. Fix: reinstate `const r = await saveDriveSettings(link, path);`. Reproduction: open drive-connect-button -> drive-settings-dialog -> drive-root-save-button; without the fix every save shows error toast even though PUT /api/drive/settings returns 200. With the fix: 'Saved. It will be checked once Drive is connected' (Drive currently not connected => checked=false).
